de.abas.erp.db

Enum EditorAction

  • Object
    • Enum<EditorAction>
      • EditorAction
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<EditorAction>

    public enum EditorAction
extends Enum<EditorAction>
    Enumerates editor actions that can be used in EditorCommandFactory.create(EditorAction, String) and its overloads.

    See Online Help: EDP Specification - EDI command for details.

    • Enum Constant Detail

      • NEW

        public static final EditorAction NEW
        Action "New" (German: "Neu").
        Effect: Creating a new data record.

      • COPY

        public static final EditorAction COPY
        Action "Copy" (German: "Kopieren").
        Effect: Creation of a new data record using an existing record as a template (copying).

      • UPDATE

        public static final EditorAction UPDATE
        Action "Update" (German: "Ändern").
        Effect: Editing of an existing record. EFOPs and EventHandlers are triggered.

      • STORE

        public static final EditorAction STORE
        Action "Store" (German: "Speichern").
        Effect: Intelligent saving of a record, regardless of whether it exists or not.
        See Online Help: EDP Specification - EDI command for further details.

      • MODIFY

        public static final EditorAction MODIFY
        Action "Modify" (German: "Modifizieren").
        Effect: Modifying the existing record using the rules of the FO, i.e.:
        • Visibility and write protection of fields applies according to FO protection in the table of variables
        • Records from the filing system can be processed
        • no core functions and no EFOPs are carried out
        • Inserting/deleting/moving lines is only permitted in additional tables

      • DELETE
